metaTitle: Custom Drawstring Backpacks with Handle | Perfect Imprints
metaDescription: Order custom drawstring backpacks with handle for your team or event. Bulk pricing at Perfect Imprints.
introHtml: Drawstring backpacks with a top handle give your promotional gear an extra layer of convenience. Unlike standard cinch sacks that rely entirely on the drawcord, these backpacks let you grab and go from a shelf or hook without digging for the straps. They are a practical choice for trade show giveaways, employee welcome kits, and school events where quick handling matters. The handle also makes them easy to hang on coat hooks or cubicle walls, keeping your logo visible at all times.
heroAltText: Custom drawstring backpacks with handle in various colors, featuring a reinforced top carry handle and printed logo
